title: Forward Fuselage
summary: Chined diamond-section forward fuselage housing the nose radome, avionics bays, cockpit pressure tub, and nose landing gear well.
role: Provides low-observable forward shaping, aerodynamic chine vortex generation at high angle of attack, and structural support for the cockpit and nose gear.
materials: Titanium bulkheads, aluminum-alloy frames, and composite outer skins with radar-absorbent edge treatments (public overview).

specs.label: Shaping Feature
specs.value: Continuous lateral chines aligned with wing edges
specs.source: Lockheed Martin F-22 Raptor Product Page
